restaurant.name: Sushi Jungle
restaurant.tagline: Experience Traditional Sushi with a Vibrant Peruvian Fusion Twist

instagram.bio: If being a sushiholic is wrong, we don't want to be right! Join us at Sushi Jungle and enjoy your favorite rolls the way they're meant to be enjoyed. #miami
instagram.content_style: High-quality food photography, dark moody backgrounds, vibrant food colors, cocktail shots, promotional reels for happy hour

facebook.bio: The best sushi in the world ALL WEEK! 12pm-10pm Delivery - Pickup - Catering

tiktok.content: Food videos, restaurant tours, sushi preparation

color_palette.neon_pink: #FF69B4 (Neon pink - 'Feed Me Sushi & Kiss Me' sign)
color_palette.notes: Dark, moody aesthetic with green as dominant brand color. Gold/amber for warmth and premium feel.

typography.style: Modern, bold headlines with clean body text

logo.description: Circular logo with sushi roll icon (green/white), lowercase 'sushijungle' text in white
logo.style: Minimalist, modern, jungle-themed with sushi element
logo.illuminated_sign: Wooden backlit sign with warm amber glow

visual_identity.photography_style: Dark, moody, professional food photography with dramatic lighting
visual_identity.food_presentation: Artistic, colorful sushi rolls on dark slate/stone plates
visual_identity.interior_aesthetic: Modern, tropical-inspired with neon signs, green plants, stone walls
visual_identity.signature_element: 'Feed Me Sushi & Kiss Me' neon sign - iconic Instagram photo spot

key_phrases: If being a sushiholic is wrong, we don't want to be right!
Experience Traditional Sushi with a Vibrant Peruvian Fusion Twist
Where traditional sushi meets bold Peruvian fusion flavors
This is your sign to drop everything and head to Sushi Jungle

signature_rolls.name: Fortune Roll
signature_rolls.description: Soybean paper, avocado, masago, cream cheese, salmon tempura, topping of salmon, honey truffle oil, eel sauce, crispy rice, gold leaf, microgreens

signature_rolls.name: Safari Roll
signature_rolls.description: Soybean paper, salmon, crab salad, avocado, crunchy crab, cream cheese, topping of salmon, avocado, and sweet and sour sauce

signature_rolls.name: Fuji Roll
signature_rolls.description: Shrimp tempura, avocado, cream cheese, masago, sesame seeds, topping of avocado, chopped shrimp tempura with honey mustard, eel sauce, crispy rice

signature_rolls.name: Protein Roll
signature_rolls.description: Soybean paper riceless roll with tuna, salmon, avocado, crab salad, cream cheese, spicy mayo, eel sauce, crispy rice

signature_rolls.name: Tsunami Roll
signature_rolls.description: Soybean paper, masago, creamcheese, fried kani, bacon, shrimp tempura, crab salad, sweet and sour sauce, eel sauce, ebi shrimp

signature_rolls.name: Jaguar Roll
signature_rolls.description: Shrimp tempura, avocado, cream cheese, plantain, spicy mayo, eel sauce

signature_rolls.name: Tiger Roll
signature_rolls.description: Shrimp tempura, crab salad, spicy mayo, topping of crab salad with crunchy crab, sweet and sour sauce

signature_rolls.name: Tropical Roll
signature_rolls.description: Soybean paper, shrimp tempura or salmon tempura, avocado, cream cheese, crab salad, plantain, spicy mayo, eel sauce, crispy rice

popular_appetizers.name: Sushi Pizza
popular_appetizers.description: Crispy rice topped with crab salad, salmon, avocado, wakame, masago, crispy rice, sesame seeds, eel sauce, sweet and sour sauce

desserts.name: Chocolate Roll
desserts.description: Chocolate cake rolled with icecream, nutella, and maria cookies, topping of strawberry, dulce de leche

signature_cocktails.name: Happy Hour Special
signature_cocktails.description: 2-for-1 cocktails, $5 wine and beer, Buy 1 get 1 50% off rolls

happy_hour.promotion: Heavily promoted on Instagram and UberEats

promotions: Sushi Jungle Rewards program (earn points for free food)

content_strategy.instagram_focus: High-quality food reels, behind-the-scenes preparation, lifestyle shots with cocktails
content_strategy.influencer_marketing: Featured by Miami food bloggers (peakacity, explorewithgg, mayitakeabite)
content_strategy.ugc: Strong user-generated content from customers sharing food photos
content_strategy.hashtag_strategy: Mix of local Miami hashtags and food-specific hashtags
content_strategy.posting_frequency: Regular posts and reels, promotional content for happy hour

target_audience.secondary: Tourists and visitors to Miami area
target_audience.psychographic: Food enthusiasts, date night seekers, social media users, sushi lovers
target_audience.demographic: Mix of Latin and American clientele (bilingual marketing)

competitive_positioning.usp: Japanese-Peruvian fusion in a trendy, Instagram-worthy setting at accessible prices
differentiators: Unique Peruvian-Japanese fusion concept (rare in Doral)
Iconic 'Feed Me Sushi & Kiss Me' neon sign photo spot
Cozy, intimate atmosphere ('Brickell vibes in Doral')
competitive_positioning.positioning: Premium casual - upscale experience at accessible prices

positive_themes: Excellent service (staff: Fabiana, Sofia, Laura mentioned frequently)
areas_for_improvement: Wait times can be long during peak hours
Portion sizes of some hot dishes

The best sushi spot in Miami
